//: Reference corpus for measuring Hinglish accuracy.
Every accuracy number quoted before this file existed came from an
English text-to-speech voice reading Roman Hinglish, because the
development machine has no Hindi voice. That proxy produced two wrong
conclusions. These phrases exist to be read by a real speaker.
Categories are scored separately, because 'accuracy' hides the thing we
actually need to know. A model can look fine on average while being
unusable on mid-sentence switching, and a Hindi fine-tune can win overall
while quietly destroying English - which is the specific regression risk
Write what you SAID, not what you meant. If you misread a line, either
re-record it or edit the reference text to match.
Recordings are NOT committed: they are your voice, and this is a public
